Multi-Stop Routing engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Apple's Multi-Stop Routing rollout covers storefront language. Xcode, system frameworks, and Connect actually separate in-app multi-stop route planning from product-page copy:

  • Apple Maps Multi-Stop Routing — Apple Maps feature that lets users add multiple stops and waypoints along one route, reorder stops, and navigate leg-by-leg. Controls multi-stop route behavior on device — not App Store language.
  • MapKit multi-stop request chains — frameworks some apps use to geocode waypoints, build multi-leg MKDirections requests, optimize stop order, or render intermediate stop lists. Your listing may mention Multi-Stop Routing; wiring waypoint insertion and route recalculation is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • Stop list & waypoint insertion UI — separate in-app or system surfaces where buyers add stops, drag to reorder, and preview multi-stop directions before navigation. Listing copy explains those buyer benefits; multi-leg routing wiring is outside AppLocale scope.
  • Location permissions & navigation background modes — NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription and active-route location for multi-leg turn-by-turn. Entitlements and routing wiring are platform work — distinct from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains Multi-Stop Routing to buyers.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Multi-Stop Routing support in the binary.

A working Multi-Stop Routing story and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

Multi-Stop Routing-specific listing copy — what translates differently

Multi-stop route planning listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe Apple Maps Multi-Stop Routing — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Multi-Stop Routing phrasing

US pages use "Multi-Stop Routing", "Multi-Stop Directions", "Add Multiple Stops", "Waypoints Along a Route", "Add Stops", "Reorder Stops", or "Plan a route with multiple stops." Apple's Simplified Chinese Maps vocabulary often uses 多站路线 for general multi-stop route marketing, 途经点 for waypoint and intermediate-stop frames, 添加途经点 for add-stops action callouts, and 多站导航 for multi-stop navigation on active-route frames. AppLocale aligns phrasing with Apple's consumer-facing terms while keeping your app's voice — not inventing multi-stop workflows Apple Maps does not offer.

Stop list vs add-stop vs reorder vs navigate

Screenshot overlays differ by workflow step — multi-stop route panel with stop list, add-stop search sheet, drag-to-reorder UI, or leg-by-leg navigation with intermediate stops highlighted. Chinese buyers expect concise labels on gallery frames that match the step shown — 添加途经点 for add-stop action, 途经点 for waypoint list frames, 多站路线 for multi-stop route outcome — not English "Add Multiple Stops" pasted through machine translation.

Multi-Stop Routing vs MapKit directions

When your English listing markets both Multi-Stop Routing and in-app directions, zh-Hans overlays must separate 多站路线 / 途经点 vocabulary from 地图 / 导航 / 附近 MapKit directions vocabulary — distinct buyer promises with different screenshot frames on the same product page. MapKit may show a single route preview as secondary UI; Multi-Stop Routing leads with several stops on one trip.

Multi-Stop Routing vs EV Routing or Share ETA

Multi-Stop Routing is general intermediate stops along one route — errands, deliveries, or sightseeing. EV Routing is charging infrastructure stops for electric vehicles — 充电站 is not 途经点 for general errands. Share ETA is live estimated arrival time sharing with contacts — 分享到达时间 is not multi-stop planning. If your app supports multiple surfaces, scope each screenshot frame accurately.

Terms like 多站路线, 途经点, and 添加途经点 each signal different intent from 充电站 EV Routing keywords or 室内地图 Indoor Maps keywords.
